reviewed_by: Claude review of workspace entry error handling
reason: Three workspace paths turned predictable conditions into 500s or leaked host paths. WorkspaceService.rename and delete resolved the request path with _relative_parts without require_value, so '.' or './' (which pass the request validators' min_length=1) produced an empty tuple and relative[-1] raised IndexError inside a try that only catches FileNotFoundError: PATCH or DELETE /workspace/entry?path=. returned 500 instead of 422. WorkspaceService.list called entry.stat unguarded inside os.scandir, so a file removed by a terminal or execution between scandir and stat (a race workspace.search already guards) failed the whole file-tree refresh with 500. WorkspaceOutputService.read opened the file after _safe_path's checks with no PermissionError mapping, so an unreadable file reached the model as a raw PermissionError carrying the absolute host path, while search on the same file returned the sanitized 'workspace path is inaccessible: permission denied'. rename and delete now require a path segment (422 'workspace file path is required'), list skips entries that vanish mid-walk, and read maps PermissionError to the same sanitized ToolOutputAccessError as search. test_workspace covers the root-path 422s and the vanished-entry listing; test_workspace_tool_search covers the read refusal without the host path; the rest of both files covers the surrounding listing, mutation, upload, reset and search paths.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change; the UI already renders 422 details and continues on a listing. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (matched through the remaining-core fallback for workspace.py and tool_results.py) is the real-Core journey suite and does not send root-path mutations or race the listing; the Python tests drive the exact paths through the API and service. No full suites.
